summary: Publish Codex bootstrap fixture exit status only after its contents are complete.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. This changes only the isolated Codex bootstrap test fixture.

schema.detail: No stored field, schema, checkpoint or digest format changes.

rules.detail: No production or admission rule changes. The bound-shell fixture writes its exit status to a same-directory temporary file and atomically renames it before the test reader can see it.

compatibility.detail: No CLI, client, wire or declaration format changes.

downtime.detail: No running service or seat is changed by this fixture correction.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes; ordinary source rollback restores the earlier fixture.
